purpose: Human-reviewed viewpoint labels and pairwise usefulness judgments for development-only detail-reference evaluation.

axes.roll_degrees: Optional visible in-plane rotation in degrees, normalized to [-180, 180). Do not infer head roll from crop rotation.

match_judgments.same: The reference has a materially matching visible view for the queried feature.
match_judgments.near: The view differs modestly but remains structurally useful for the queried feature.
match_judgments.incompatible: The view is structurally misleading or unsuitable for the query despite subject/style similarity.
match_judgments.indeterminate: Available visual evidence cannot support a reliable judgment.
match_judgments.not_applicable: A viewpoint comparison is not meaningful for this pair.

rules: Indeterminate is a valid reviewed judgment and must not be coerced to frontal.
A viewpoint label describes visible evidence, not artist intent or a hidden final image.
Use parent context when an isolated crop obscures orientation cues.
Viewpoint labels and usefulness judgments are separate annotations.
This rubric does not establish retrieval accuracy or authorize training.
